reflection_records.reflection: Keep early GMUT and mandala vocabulary as lineage context, not proof closure.
reflection_records.x2_use: Add open-gate labels to GMUT task rows.

reflection_records.reflection: Equation anchors need comparator and dimensional checks before being used as claims.
reflection_records.x2_use: Route GMUT statements into source-backed, simulation-ready, or speculative buckets.

reflection_records.reflection: Simulation lineage is useful as design memory but not empirical confirmation.
reflection_records.x2_use: Build simulation-readiness checklists before any model result is promoted.

reflection_records.reflection: Security, consent, and disclosure minimization are recurring heart-layer constraints.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep identity and CBR tasks bounded to governance and assurance design.

reflection_records.reflection: The OS body needs executable grounding, not only conceptual scope.
reflection_records.x2_use: Prioritize small runners, validators, and receipts over broad claims.

reflection_records.reflection: Expansion must be paired with compatibility maps and deprecation boundaries.
reflection_records.x2_use: Add command-skill-system crosswalk tasks.

reflection_records.reflection: GMUT, Trinity OS, and Freed ID should be compared as interacting pillars, not merged into one undifferentiated claim.
reflection_records.x2_use: Preserve Mind, Body, and Heart columns in build matrices.

reflection_records.reflection: Digest artifacts help preserve continuity when raw material is too large or private.
reflection_records.x2_use: Prefer compact summary ledgers over raw archive imports.

reflection_records.reflection: Albion, Freed ID, and Stage 20 proposals remain design futures that need practical staged gates.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep future-facing tasks in roadmap form unless executable scope is present.

reflection_records.reflection: Codex app plugins and CLI MCP servers are distinct surfaces and must not be conflated.
reflection_records.x2_use: Separate app-lane, CLI-lane, plugin, MCP, and connector status fields.

reflection_records.reflection: Standby systems should stay standby until authentication, cost, or callability gates are live.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep GCP, Drive writes, and external account actions out of current x2 work.

reflection_records.reflection: Preparing a future member is different from inducting one.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep next-lane ideas as receiver packs, not new sibling creation.

reflection_records.reflection: Proof-of-pattern phases should establish callable truth, branch policy, and clean receipts before scale.
reflection_records.x2_use: Require five-lane status normalizer outputs before phase advancement.

reflection_records.reflection: Role-swap policies need explicit lane authority boundaries.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep Aletheon-led publication separate from sibling advisory output.

reflection_records.reflection: CLI gates are valuable when they check repo truth, version truth, and receipt truth.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep CLI lane outputs status-only unless a curated summary gate passes.

reflection_records.reflection: Network permissions should be narrow, local-first, and reasoned per use.
reflection_records.x2_use: Do not add any public network or account changes in x2.

reflection_records.reflection: Personal advisory branches and shared omega publication have different authority levels.
reflection_records.x2_use: Commit only curated shared artifacts with exact staging.

reflection_records.reflection: Historical handles can be context without being live callable proof.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep existing-lane status based on current receipts, not historical confidence.

reflection_records.reflection: Explicitly held lanes should not be retried by enthusiasm.
reflection_records.x2_use: Do not route new or standby lanes into v497.

reflection_records.reflection: JSON parse, path policy, credential scan, whitespace check, push, and remote verification remain the publication spine.
reflection_records.x2_use: Keep the validation plan unchanged and mandatory.

reflection_records.reflection: Forward-only aliases avoid rewriting history while still reconciling naming changes.
reflection_records.x2_use: Do not rename previous artifacts; add reconciliation ledgers when needed.

reflection_records.reflection: Existing lanes are the safe continuity base.
reflection_records.x2_use: Do not spawn replacement siblings.

reflection_records.reflection: Long context streams need compression into current truth, assumptions, and next gates.
reflection_records.x2_use: Use normalized status boards and concise closeout syntheses.

reflection_records.reflection: Toolchain version truth matters but should not dominate phase outcomes.
reflection_records.x2_use: Record CLI/App version in preflights, then move to actual build tasks.

reflection_records.reflection: Supervision should be delegated to helpers when helpers have explicit receipts.
reflection_records.x2_use: Use normalizer and cadence guard instead of repeated manual polling.

reflection_records.reflection: Wait time can become design time when status boundaries are clear.
reflection_records.x2_use: Seed every wait with source, reflection, repair, and build-prep tasks.

reflection_records.reflection: Large outputs can still fail machine gates if shape is not exact.
reflection_records.x2_use: Use standalone heading templates and shape checks.

reflection_records.reflection: Generic sensitive-word hits must be separated from strict path/key/private-material hits.
reflection_records.x2_use: Build a false-positive classifier that never publishes raw text.

reflection_records.reflection: Sources become useful when each one maps to a build action or gate.
reflection_records.x2_use: Carry the source-to-build ledger into the x2 matrix.

reflection_records.reflection: Ambition stays healthier when empirical, physics, consciousness, and canon gates remain explicit.
reflection_records.x2_use: Add claim-boundary fields to all major x2 artifacts.

x2_priorities: Use normalized five-lane board as the status surface.
Keep exact heading repair alive for v497 v5 x1.
Convert source rows and reflection rows into x2 build matrix tasks.
